user.title: Network Info
user.description: Scans your network for all devices and, when router access is configured, shows which path each device uses (LAN, 2.4 GHz or 5 GHz Wi-Fi). Leave the router fields empty to use scanning only.

data_description.ip_range: CIDR (192.168.1.0/24), dash range (192.168.1.1-254) or several ranges separated by spaces. Pre-filled from Home Assistant's own network.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to scan, in minutes.
data_description.router_host: IP address of your Xiaomi/MiWiFi router. Needed only for connection-path and signal information.
data_description.router_password: The router's admin (web UI) password. Leave empty to skip router polling.

error.invalid_ip_range: Enter at least one IP range to scan.
error.password_without_host: Enter the router address to use the router password.
error.invalid_auth: The router rejected the admin password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the router at this address.

abort.already_configured: This IP range is already configured.
